A1.justification: Local reading tools stalled without returning document content from either PDF; the PDF skill file also could not be read. The work's identity and material completeness, including appendices, could not be verified. This is an access limitation, not evidence of missing document content.

before.justification: No readable content was obtained from v2.pdf, so the presence of original empirical results could not be established.

after.justification: No readable content was obtained from v3.pdf, so the presence of original empirical results could not be established.

M1.justification: The methods could not be inspected; changes to algorithms, models, objectives, or inference procedures remain unresolved.

E1.justification: Dataset and task coverage could not be read or matched across the versions.

E2.justification: The reported comparisons were unavailable, preventing verification of which baselines participated in corresponding experiments.

E3.justification: Experimental settings and protocols could not be inspected, so revisions cannot be distinguished from newly disclosed details.

E4.justification: Ablations, robustness tests, and supplementary analyses could not be inspected in either the main text or appendices.

E5.justification: Run counts, seed information, and uncertainty reporting could not be read or compared.

E6.justification: No result passages, tables, or figures were accessible for checking numerical values, rankings, or qualitative findings.

T1.justification: Definitions, assumptions, derivations, and proofs could not be inspected, including any appendix material.

C1.justification: The abstracts, introductions, and conclusions could not be read, leaving changes to core claims unresolved.

C2.justification: Interpretations, mechanism explanations, applicability boundaries, and limitations could not be compared.

D1.justification: Implementation details and reproducibility disclosures could not be inspected in either version.

R1.justification: Related-work discussions and references were inaccessible, preventing assessment of citation or research-positioning changes.

P1.justification: The text and section structures could not be inspected, so the extent of rewriting or reorganization is unknown.

P2.justification: No rendered pages were obtained, preventing comparison of figures, tables, captions, and layout.

improvement.justification: Neither PDF could be inspected with the available local tools. Without before-and-after evidence from the papers and their appendices, the overall quality difference cannot be judged reliably.
